caption: A bank of switches in a school gym is flipped one at a time, and the rows of ceiling lights come on one row at a time.

sa.check: A school gym with rows of ceiling lights and a bank of switches.
The switches are flipped one at a time.
The rows of ceiling lights come on one row at a time.
The lights are dark before the first flip.
Each row lights after its own flip, in the order the switches are flipped.

pc.expect: Each flip is followed at that moment by one row lighting; rows whose switch is untouched stay dark.
pc.fail: A switch is flipped and no row lights; or a row lights with no switch flipped; or several rows light at one flip; or a row lights before its switch is touched.

pc.expect: The rows that light are the fixtures seen dark: the same number of rows and fixtures in the same positions.
pc.fail: A lit row appears where no fixtures hung; or fixtures vanish when lit; or the number of rows changes between frames; or fixtures shift along the ceiling.

pc.expect: The floor under each lit row brightens, with the lit area growing row by row.
pc.fail: A row glows while the floor beneath stays as dark as before; or the whole floor brightens at the first row; or the floor brightens while the fixtures stay dark.

pc.expect: Once a row is lit it stays lit; the sequence only adds rows.
pc.fail: A lit row goes dark by itself; or rows flicker; or a row goes dark when the next switch is flipped; or rows go dark and relight.

pc.expect: The gym's walls, floor markings and fixtures keep their shapes; the hand passes through nothing.
pc.fail: The fixtures change shape; or the hand passes through the switch plate; or the floor markings change; or the gym's layout changes between dark and lit frames.

pc.expect: The wall and floor colours and the switch plate stay the same apart from brightness.
pc.fail: The floor changes colour rather than brightness; or the switch plate changes layout; or the walls change colour.
